description: HairDora connects ChatGPT to your salon's scheduling data through a read-only, OAuth-protected connection. You can list your salons, check opening hours and bookable availability, review providers and the service catalog, look up appointment schedules and quote or payment status, and open an aggregate salon overview. It never returns client contact details or free-text notes, and it cannot book, cancel, charge or otherwise change a record. Open the sidebar to browse salons, service prices, upcoming appointment previews and availability.

defaultPrompt: Open HairDora and show my salons, then summarize Review Downtown.
Show Review Downtown’s service catalog and available booking slots.
What is on Review Downtown’s schedule for the next seven days?
